name: Will I have a single point of contact throughout the project?

mainEntity.name: Will I have a single point of contact throughout the project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in a well-run design-build project you typically work with one primary project manager or project lead who coordinates the larger team and communicates updates, next steps, and decisions.
